create_kscript_generator: create a KScriptGenerator to produce random Kaleidoscope code files with configurable function counts
build_timing_script: build a TimingScriptGenerator that writes a bash script to time toy-mcjit and toy-jit executions
generate_kaleidoscope_scripts: generate random Kaleidoscope scripts with specified function counts, elements per function, and call weighting
run_timing_benchmarks: run timing benchmarks comparing MCJIT and JIT execution of generated Kaleidoscope scripts
update_function_call_map: update the function call map to track which functions call other functions in generated code
